# Shivam Mahajan — SM'S DEX

> SM'S DEX is Shivam Mahajan's interactive software developer portfolio and knowledge engine. It presents his engineering work, 2,002 Days of Code streak (1,500+ LeetCode solutions), and hosts a reviewed public developer roster.

For the complete concatenated markdown knowledge base, see [llms-full.txt](https://shivammahajan.com/llms-full.txt).

## Selected Software & Personal Projects
- **Productivity Caller**: Native Android reminder app built with Kotlin and Jetpack Compose utilizing scheduled phone calls.
- **SM'S DEX**: High-performance Pokédex developer portfolio built with Astro and Web Audio API chiptune synthesis.
- **Flight Sun Tracker**: Solar elevation & passenger window seat shade calculator along great-circle routes in TypeScript and HTML5 Canvas.
- **ClickHouse Ingestion Tool**: Bidirectional data pipeline connecting ClickHouse OLAP databases and CSV flat files.
- **Clickless**: Mouseless keyboard navigation controller written in Rust utilizing 2D screen targeting grids.
- **Chaincode**: Web3 coding platform validating code originality with Gemini AI (95%+ accuracy) and minting NFTs. 3rd of 200+ HackIndia teams.
- **Vedic Hearth**: Artisanal Vedic brassware e-commerce store (vedichearth.com).
- **BuyPeetal**: Curated 40-region global directory documenting traditional brass craft clusters and metallurgy histories (buypeetal.com).

## Public Roster & Autonomous Agent API
Visitors and autonomous AI agents can submit a Pokémon entry to the public developer roster:
- **Endpoint**: `POST https://api.github.com/repos/smresponsibilities/smresponsibilities.github.io/issues`
- **Headers**: `Accept: application/vnd.github+json`, `Authorization: Bearer <GITHUB_TOKEN>`
- **Payload**:
```json
{
  "title": "[DEX] <github_username>",
  "labels": ["submission"],
  "body": "### GitHub username\n<username>\n\n### Species\n<species>\n\n### Primary type\n<primaryType>\n\n### Secondary type\n<secondaryType>\n\n### Status\n<status>\n\n### Current employer\n<company>\n\n### Dex entry\n<entry>\n\n### Fact / tip (optional)\n<fact>"
}
```
Validation rules: Valid GitHub username, species (max 24 chars), primary/secondary Pokémon type, status (`Caught` | `Released` | `Uncaught`), company (if caught), dex entry (max 150 chars).
